campaign.context: A small business without a dedicated PR contact wants to promote a new product or service.

steps.title: Campaign details
steps.description: Decide the title and summarize the main content.

fields.label: Main content
fields.placeholder: What is new, when is it available, and why should customers care?

steps.title: Choose how to write
steps.description: Select self-publishing or ask PR TIMES to prepare the article.

options.title: Write it yourself
options.description: Prepare and submit the release in the next step.

options.title: Use the PR TIMES writing service
options.description: Submit materials, then arrange an interview.

steps.title: Submit your release
steps.description: Add the existing title, subtitle, article, and supporting media.

steps.title: Submit materials
steps.description: Share the product information, images, videos, and brand details with PR TIMES.

fields.label: Product and store information
fields.placeholder: Share the product details, pricing, launch period, and store story.

steps.title: Arrange an interview
steps.description: Choose a time to explain the store, product, and campaign story to PR TIMES.

steps.title: Reserve publication time
steps.description: Select the specific date and time when the article should be published.
